name: Deploy
description: Authority to make already-built software live. Successor to deploy@0.6, which gated 'build and deploy this commit'; this gates 'promote this artifact', because building is not consequential and publishing is. Promotion activates bytes that already exist, so the human can inspect the artifact before approving and no rebuild can diverge from what was approved. Host-agnostic: the artifact identifier is a Vercel deployment id, a container image digest, an Azure slot — the connector manifest names it, this profile never does.

promote_daily_max.description: How often software may be made live per day. Counted by the Authority Server, so a compromised gateway cannot exceed it. Creating a preview is NOT counted here — it is not consequential.

rollback_allowed.description: Whether the agent may promote a PREVIOUS artifact back to live. Its own action type: reverting carries different risk from releasing, and the artifact being restored was approved for a moment that has passed.

allowed_repos.description: Repositories the agent may deploy from, e.g. humanagencyprotocol/hap

allowed_environments.description: Deployment targets the agent may reach. Deliberately NOT an enum: hosts disagree — GitHub uses names you define, Vercel has production and preview, Netlify has deploy-preview and branch-deploy. The connector discovers the real list.

allowed_workflows.description: Named pipelines the agent may run, e.g. deploy.yml. Scoping by pipeline rather than by 'deploy' means adding CI later — a migration, an infrastructure apply — is an edit to this list, not a new profile. The limit of this approach: the grant knows a pipeline is permitted, not what it does. The name has to carry that meaning to the human signing.

allowed_branches.description: Branches a deployable commit may come from. Optional: a host with no branch concept leaves it empty.

action_type.description: promote or rollback — declared by the manifest, never taken from an agent argument

allowed_repos.description: Repository this action targets, checked against the authorized set

allowed_environments.description: Environment this action targets, checked against the authorized set. Recorded in the receipt, so the proof names where the release went.

allowed_workflows.description: Pipeline this action runs, checked against the authorized set. Recorded in the receipt, so the proof names what ran.
